site.name: Natural Healthy Village Kaengkrachan
site.description: Exclusive residential land community near Kaengkrachan National Park. Private lake, chapel island, 360° mountain views, self-sustainable infrastructure. 6 plots remaining from 16 total.

topics.title: Land Pricing and Available Plots at Natural Healthy Village
topics.title_th: ราคาที่ดินและแปลงที่มีจำหน่าย
topics.summary: Six residential plots remain from 16 total at Natural Healthy Village Kaengkrachan, priced from 2,500,000 to 7,000,000 THB with Chanote title deeds.
questions: How much does land cost at Natural Healthy Village Kaengkrachan?
What plot sizes are for sale?

sections.heading: Plots currently available
sections.body: As of 2026, six plots remain from sixteen total: Plot 1 (1,396 m², 3,500,000 THB), Plot 2a (1,070 m², 2,500,000 THB), Plot 3 (2,056 m², 5,000,000 THB), Plot 6 (2,824 m², 7,000,000 THB), Plot 9 (2,324 m², 6,500,000 THB), Plot 16 (2,164 m², 5,400,000 THB).

sections.heading: What affects price
sections.body: Plot price reflects size (1,070–2,824 m²), position, and views. All plots include access to more than 12 rai of common green space, the private lake, walkways, and shared infrastructure. Residential use only — no commercial development.

sections.heading: Title and tenure
sections.body: All plots hold Chanote title deeds (the highest land security in Thailand). Thai nationals may purchase freehold. Foreign nationals may register a 30-year renewable lease.

faqs.question: What is the lowest priced plot?
faqs.answer: Plot 2a is the entry plot at 2,500,000 THB for 1,070 m² (2 ngan 70 wah).

faqs.question: Are prices negotiable?
faqs.answer: Contact the project team for current availability and to arrange a site visit. Phone 081 860 4501 (English/French) or 095 365 2500 (Thai).

topics.title: Buying Land as a Foreigner — 30-Year Lease at NHVK
topics.title_th: ชาวต่างชาติซื้อที่ดิน — สัญญาเช่า 30 ปี
topics.summary: Foreign nationals cannot own land freehold in Thailand but may hold a registered 30-year renewable lease at Natural Healthy Village with Chanote-backed plots.
questions: Can foreigners buy land at Natural Healthy Village?
What is a 30-year lease in Thailand?
Is the lease registered on the Chanote title?

sections.heading: Freehold vs lease
sections.body: Thai law restricts foreign freehold land ownership. At Natural Healthy Village, Thai buyers may purchase with full Chanote ownership. Foreign buyers typically use a 30-year registered lease, which is a legally recognised long-term tenure commonly used for residential land in Thailand.

sections.heading: Why Chanote matters
sections.body: Every plot at NHVK holds a Chanote title deed — the most secure form of land title in Thailand. A registered lease on Chanote land provides clarity for long-term residential use and inheritance planning. Always consult a Thai property lawyer for your personal situation.

sections.heading: Who to contact
sections.body: For English and French enquiries: Philippe Bremard, 081 860 4501, kaengkrachan.village@proton.me. Full brochure available on request. Site visits welcome.

faqs.question: Can the 30-year lease be renewed?
faqs.answer: Leases are commonly structured with renewal options; specific terms are set in the sale/lease agreement and should be reviewed with legal counsel.

faqs.question: Is this a resort or hotel project?
faqs.answer: No. Natural Healthy Village is residential land only — a private community for weekend homes or permanent residence, not commercial tourism.

topics.title: Self-Sustainable Solar, Water and Utilities at NHVK
topics.title_th: พลังงานและน้ำพึ่งพาตนเอง
topics.summary: Natural Healthy Village is designed for energy and water autonomy: solar panels in progress, private deep well, 3-phase PEA electricity, three water lines per plot, and all cables buried underground.
questions: Does Natural Healthy Village have solar power?
What water supply does each plot have?

sections.heading: Electricity
sections.body: 3-phase electricity from PEA (Provincial Electricity Authority) with an individual meter per plot. Solar panel installation is in progress toward full energy autonomy. All electrical cables are buried underground — no poles or overhead wires obstructing mountain views.

sections.heading: Water
sections.body: Each plot has three water supply lines with individual meters. The project includes a private deep well, water storage tank, and pump. Connection to public water supply is also available.

sections.heading: Design philosophy
sections.body: Self-sustainability supports weekend and permanent residents who want independence from city utilities while remaining ~2.5 hours from Bangkok. Infrastructure is built for long-term residential use, not short-term tourism.

faqs.question: Is solar fully operational?
faqs.answer: Solar panels are being installed; the project is working toward full energy autonomy. Contact the team for current status on your visit.

faqs.question: Can I grow food on my plot?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plots range from 1,070 to 2,824 m² — enough for fruit trees, vegetables, and private gardens.
